title_sq: Apartament 2+1 ne shitje te Rruga Sulejman Delvina ne Tirane
description_sq:
Rruga Sulejman Delvina, prane shtepise se ofertave, shitet apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe 112 m2 , kati 5 (i fundit), ne pallat egzistues. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar nga soxhorno, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, korridor dhe 2 ballkone. Apartamenti eshte i gjithe i rikonstruktuar me tavane te varura ( te mbushur me lesh guri), i gjithe i patinuar, instalime elektrike, parket, kondicioner. Orientimi Jug/Perendim.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor
Shitet 18 000 000 Leke
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on Sulejman Delvina Street in Tirana
description_en: Sulejman Delvina Street, near the house of offers, 2+1 apartment for sale with an area of ​​112 m2, 5th floor (top), in the existing building. The apartment is organized by living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, corridor and 2 balconies. The apartment is completely reconstructed with suspended ceilings (filled with stone wool), all patinated, electrical installations, parquet, air conditioning. Orientation South/West. The property has regular mortgage documentation. For sale: 18,000,000 Lek
